question: I would like to ask the following questions in relation to Regulation (EU) 2024/9001 and the upcoming stakeholder review: 1.
Has the Commission reviewed the guidelines issued by the Commission in relation to this regulation and is it satisfied that they can be readily understood by all relevant political actors?
Will the guidelines be updated at least once a year to reflect practical experience in the context of recent elections?
Has any estimate been made of the compliance costs these rules impose on political parties, candidates and other political actors?

Regulation (EU) 2024/900 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 March 2024 on the transparency and targeting of political advertising (OJ L, 2024/900, 20.3.2024, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/900/oj). 1
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (23.7.2026) Regulation (EU) 2024/9001 provides for EU common standards on the transparency and targeting of political advertising. In line with this Regulation, sponsors have to ensure the truthfulness and accuracy of the relevant information provided to providers of political advertising services.

Political actors, including political parties or candidates in elections, typically act as sponsors. The guidelines2 issued in October 2025 by the Commission support the effective implementation of Regulation (EU) 2024/900. They include practical guidance and detailed explanations to help those sponsoring ads – such as political actors – and providers of political advertising services to implement the new rules.

The Commission may revise these guidelines in the future, to take into account the lessons learned from the implementation, including in the context of recent elections. The Commission actively supports the recently establish network gathering contact points of national competent authorities. This network acts as a forum for structured cooperation and exchanging of best practices among authorities.
The Commission has also set up an expert group with providers of political advertising services.
